term: box of guarded forall to guarded forall of box
definition: For every arbitrary total P and evaluation world w, if every existing candidate at each accessible v satisfies P v, then every candidate existing at w satisfies P at all accessible v. The outer existence guard is evaluated at w, the boxed guard at v.
note: Approved source-free semantic interface for fixed-roster actualist domain transfer. No physical or metaphysical domain policy is asserted. No free-logic proof calculus, counterpart semantics, or general quantified syntax is introduced.
